decay_factors.factor: Weekend B2B Tech Feed Drops (Saturday / Sunday)

decay_factors.factor: Outbound Repository Link in Main Post Body
decay_factors.evidence: Both Candidate #1 and #5 included raw GitHub URLs in the post body, subjecting them to LinkedIn off-platform penalty. Moving links to the 1st comment is now enforced.
